Accidents due to derailment
†*61. SHRIMATI PREMA
CARIAPPA:
SHRI MOTILAL VORA:
Will the Minister of RAILWAYS be
pleased to state:
(a) the number of train accidents
occurred due to derailment during the last
four years;
(b) the main reasons thereof and the
steps taken by Government to stop these
accidents;
(c) whether it is a fact that the
Bangalore Express met with an accident
on 21st December, 2002; and
(d) if so, the details of loss of lives
and property and the reasons for accident?
Strategic plans to counter drought
*62. SHRI MOTILAL VORA:
SHRI SANTOSH BAGRODIA:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have worked
on strategic plans to counter the drought in
the coming year, in dry States like Rajasthan,
Gujarat, MP etc.;
(b) if so, the highlights of such a plan;
(c) if not, whether Government realize
that planning to counter drought conditions
needs to be done in advance; and
(d) if so, what steps Government
propose to take to protect the standing
crops when the drought conditions arise
this summer?
Grants and aids to fraudulent
educational institutions
*63. SHRI K.B. KRISHNA
MURTHY:
SHRI SANTOSH BAGRODIA:
Will the Minister of HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that there were
many fraudulent universities, colleges and
schools in Southern India that were getting
grants and aid from Government;
(b) if so, number of such schools,
colleges and universities receiving aid
from Government have closed down
during the past three years;

Environmental education
*64. SHRI H.K. JAVARE GOWDA:
Will the Minister of ENVIRONMENT
AND FORESTS be pleased to state:
(a) the details of the schemes and the
steps taken by Government for
environmental education, awareness and
training during the last three years;
(b) whether World Bank assistance has
been taken to promote Environment
Management Capacity Building Project in
the State of Karnataka; and
(c) if so, the details thereof and the
amount spent thereon during the last three
years in that State?
New Kendriya Vidyalayas
*65. SHRI RAMADHAR KASHYAP:
Will the Minister of HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
have decided to open 100 new Kendriya
Vidyalayas in the ensuing academic
session; and
(b) if so, the details thereof, State-wise/
UT-wise?
Setting up of a regional office of
National Innovation Foundation at
Guwahati
*66. DR. ARUN KUMAR SARMA:
Will the Minister of SCIENCE AND
TECHNOLOGY be pleased to state:
(a) the objectives and achievements of
forming National Innovation Foundation;
(b) list of programmes taken up for
implementation during the Tenth Five Year
Plan;
(c) whether Government had decided to
set up a North Eastern Regional office of
National Innovation Foundation at
Guwahati; and
(d) if so, the target set and the progress
made therefor?
Accreditation to educational
institutions
*67. SHRI JANARDHANA
POOJARY: Will the Minister of HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) whether UGC is or not required to
consult the concerned administrative
Ministry/authority before awarding
NAAC (National Assessment and
Accreditation Council) accreditation or the
'deemed to be University status' on an
institution;
(b) whether it is a fact that in a few
instances where institutions, particularly
the institutions offering professional
courses, were accorded, and continue to
be accorded, Accreditation/University status
even before the course or the college was/is
formally recognised by the administrative
Ministry; and
(c) if so, the details of such institutions
with date of conferring Accreditation/
University status and recognition by the
concerned administrative authority and
the Government's reaction thereto?
Train between Bangalore and
Vijayawada
*68. DR. VIJAY MALLYA: Will the
Minister of RAILWAYS be pleased to
state:
(a) whether in view of the heavy
demand from commuters to run express
train from Bangalore to Vijayawada and

Milk production in A.P.
317. DR. DASARI NARAYANA
RAO: Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have
extended financial assistance to Andhra
Pradesh to boost milk production in the
State;
(b) if so, the details thereof for the last
three years, year-wise; and
(c) what results were achieved in milk
production in the State during the said
period?
Menace of fruit flies
318. SHRI NANA DESHMUKH: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the flies cause
losses worth Rs. 2945 crores per annum to
various fruits; and
(b) if so, the details of steps being
taken to control the menace of fruit
flies?
State Agriculture Ministers'
Conference
319. SHRI KARNENDU BHATTA-
CHARJEE: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether in a recent Conference of the
State Agriculture Ministers, a resolution was
passed unanimously demanding that
National Bank of Agriculture and Rural
Development (NABARD) should be
brought under the administrative control of
the Ministry of Agriculture and if so,
Government's reaction thereto;
(b) whether any steps have been taken
to give effect to the resolution and if not, the
reasons therefor; and
(c) what other decisions were taken at
the Conference to make the agriculture policy
farmer friendly?
Food and Fodder Development in
Karnataka
320. DR. VIJAY MALLYA: Will the
Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether the Karnataka Government
has submitted schemes for strengthening of

74

State farms, establishment of Fodder Bank
etc., at an estimated cost of Rs. 93 lakhs;
(b) if so, what is the present stage of
consideration of this proposal; and
(c)  by when the State Government is
likely to receive the sanction of the schemes
and release of funds in this regard?
Drought relief price for rabi wheat
321. SHRI YADLAPATI VENKAT
RAO: Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government had paid
Rs. 10 per quintal as drought relief to
farmers over and above the Minimum
Support Price for rabi wheat, as
recommended by the Commission for
Agricultural Costs and Prices; and
(b) if so, the details of amount paid to
drought affected States for the same,
State-wise?
Foodgrains/fruits production in H.P.
322. SHRI ANIL SHARMA: Will the
Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased to
state:
(a) the details of target fixed for
foodgrains/fruits production during the
Tenth Five Year Plan in Himachal Pradesh;
(b) the details of steps being taken by
Government in this behalf; and
(c) the details of investments proposed
to be made in the production of foodgrains/
fruits in the State?
Milk production
323. SHRI H.K. JAVARE GOWDA:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that our country
is one of the leading milk producing country
in the World; if so, the details of production
for the last three years, State-wise;
(b) whether it is also a fact, that the milk
producers are selling their milk at cheaper
rates, compared to other countries; if so,
what are the comparative prices in other milk
producing countries; and
(c) the details of steps Government
propose to take to improve the quality of the
milk, specially for its export?
Diversification of Punjab Agriculture
324. DR. MANMOHAN SINGH: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether the Punjab Government has
submitted for Central funding a scheme for
diversification of Punjab Agriculture;
(b) if so, what are the main features of
the scheme; and
(c) the decision taken by Government in
this regard?
Milk production capacity

SHRI KAPIL SIBAL:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have found out
the possibilities of extension and
development of animal husbandry industry
in the country;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether it is a fact that India have
largest number of cattle especially milch
cattle in comparison to other countries in
the world;
